title: shape_recognize input
description: One hand-drawn stroke as ordered points. Unknown keys are refused. When closed is true the processor appends the first point; it then resamples to 128 points along arc length, centres the bounding box on the origin and scales the longer side to 1 before inference. A degenerate stroke (zero length or zero bounding box) is refused.

items.description: One [x, y] point in canvas coordinates.

points.description: The stroke in drawing order. Only the first stroke of a shape is supported.

closed.description: Whether the stroke was drawn closed; the fitted-geometry gates use it.
